description: Decompose a complex goal into a deterministic multi-agent DAG with exact BigInt micro-USDC split (zero rounding drift), verified x402 tool assignments, SHA-256 swarmManifestHash, and unsigned ERC-8183 G2 Jobs createJobWithTerms escrow calldata on Base or Arc. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

budgetUsd.description: total USDC budget (0.01 to 10000, up to 6 decimals, default 0.05)

evaluator.description: optional 0x arbitrator address (or from) for ready-to-broadcast createJobWithTerms calldata

goal.description: goal description for the multi-agent swarm (6 to 400 chars)

killFeePercent.description: kill fee percent on rejected work (0 to 25, default 0)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

provider.description: optional 0x lead worker address (defaults to zero address)

reviewHours.description: review window in hours (1 to 168, default 24)

workers.description: number of worker roles in DAG (2 to 6, default 3)
